استعجبت (form X)
# اِسْتَعْجَبْتُ (istaʕjabtu) /is.taʕ.d͡ʒab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَعْجَبَ (istaʕjaba)
# اِسْتَعْجَبْتَ (istaʕjabta) /is.taʕ.d͡ʒab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَعْجَبَ (istaʕjaba)
# اِسْتَعْجَبْتِ (istaʕjabti) /is.taʕ.d͡ʒab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَعْجَبَ (istaʕjaba)
# اِسْتَعْجَبَتْ (istaʕjabat)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
